model.description: The outer layer is the author's catalogue of causal arisings in complexity levels and phases, joined by causes that remain author hypotheses until evidence supports them; every technical record belongs to the subgraph of exactly one arising. Partial reconstruction of Level-0 definitions and scoped physical, chemical, biochemical, cellular, organismal, optical, retinal, visual and neural evidence. Levels organize the display; they do not establish a universal emergence order. Formal specifications, computational models, experimental preparations, observations and conditional interpretations have distinct roles. Each scientific claim retains its reviewed sources, selected system, observable, uncertainty, shared inputs and unresolved limitations. Field and particle models remain distinct from detector response, lattice calculations and conditional parameter extraction. Nuclear and atomic masses, primordial abundances and cosmological spectra retain their source-specific calibration, model and covariance limits. Atomic and molecular binding, prepared-state spectroscopy, charge production, electrolyte screening and stationary electronic representations address different questions; their energy comparisons do not by themselves establish formation kinetics, universal stability or a unique ancestry. Optical and neural records distinguish measured response from anatomy, intervention and theoretical interpretation. Cellular organization, state regulation, fate and immune responses retain preparation-specific perturbations, finite persistence, partial rescue, contrary outcomes and corrected controls. Model-derived metabolic flux and inferred immune networks remain distinct from measured readouts. Tissue morphogenesis, repair, extracellular mechanics, physiological coordination, retinal organization and inflammatory states retain their distinct preparation, timing, resource and endpoint boundaries. Adult observations and finite perturbations do not establish universal developmental generators, immune allocation optima, organism-wide set-points or hysteresis. Behavioral success and fitted models do not identify a unique mechanism. Finite checks reproduce only their declared data or mathematical witnesses, not entire experiments. Cross-domain construction, downward causation and a derivation of quantum theory from Level 0 remain unestablished. Reviewed descriptive bridges record the definitions, measurement principles, interpretation boundaries and topic scopes that records share across evidence islands and levels; they establish no construction, causation or level order. Source discrepancies and unreproduced stages remain explicit. No whole-graph scientific validation is claimed. Neural-system topics have explicit source-bound scope decisions: anatomy, effective signaling, memory tasks, glial/molecular/vascular interfaces and subjective reports retain distinct observables. Contextual treatment and conditioning contrasts do not establish universal psychosomatic pathways, healing, physical minima or a unique conscious mechanism. Social-system topics have explicit source-bound scope decisions. Animal interactions, human tasks, observed population associations, formal models and constitutive documents retain distinct evidence roles. Collective labels, laboratory effects and documentary rules do not establish universal social minima, weighted necessary chains, irreducibility or a measured society-wide neural mechanism.
model.name: Causal Emergence — Canonical Reconstruction
